instructions_to_main_agent: Build directly on top of commit 414feba in AppLayout.js where <main> supports full height layout (<main className="flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden"> and <Outlet /> inside <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">). Do not revert this structure.
Implement full-screen map layout for /mapas: map container data-testid="geo-map-canvas" occupies flex-1 h-full, with compressed top control bar.
Auto-hide sidebar (<aside>) in AppLayout on /mapas route, with floating or top-bar toggle button to reveal/collapse sidebar.
Place fixed Church anchor marker at 640 Demorest Rd, Columbus, OH 43204 (gold/red star-church pin), visible regardless of filters.
Use custom Google Maps style drop pins for items: Members/People (amber/blue), Front Groups (purple/centroid), Cells (green), Church (golden star).

Implement 4 cardinal zones (Zona 1 Norte, Zona 2 Este, Zona 3 Sur, Zona 4 Oeste) with 12 subzones based on distance from church anchor: A (0-3 mi), B (3-6 mi), C (>6 mi) (e.g., Zona 1-A, 1-B, 1-C). Make fill, borders, and labels distinctly visible.
Implement member/person name search box in top bar that centers and highlights member pin on selection.
Implement backend geocoding fallback chain in backend/geo_routes.py: Census API -> Geocodio API -> OSM Nominatim -> Manual review queue only as last resort.
Maintain high testability with data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, map controls, search inputs, tabs, and buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Layered depth and clear contrast across controls, map overlays, floating panels, and status chips.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover, focus, and active states with proper contrast.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons; use Lucide-react or custom SVG icons.
Avoid transition: all; use explicit property transitions like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons include role-based data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

layouts.page_structure: Full height 100vh layout with flex-col, top compact control bar (shrink-0), and map canvas occupying flex-1 relative overflow-hidden
layouts.top_bar: Compact header containing Title, Person Search Input, Tabs (Personas, Células, Grupos), Filters Dropdown, Metric Summary Strip, and Action Buttons
layouts.sidebar_behavior: Hidden on /mapas route via state in AppLayout or route detection, with a floating toggle button to show/hide sidebar navigation on demand

grids.top_bar_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-2 items-center p-3 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm z-20
grids.map_container: relative w-full h-full min-h-0 flex-1 bg-slate-100

visual enhancers.map_pins: Custom SVG pin drops with inner white icon and shadow
visual enhancers.zone_polygons: MapLibre fill and line layers with distinct stroke widths (2px) and visible subzone labels
visual enhancers.glassmorphism_floating_panels: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200 shadow-lg rounded-lg p-2

motion.map_flyto: Smooth camera transition when selecting a person from search or clicking a cell pin
motion.sidebar_slide: CSS transform transition duration-200 ease-in-out for sidebar toggle

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant text and controls against map backgrounds
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard access for search input, filter selects, and map control buttons
accessibility.test_ids: Required data-testid on search input (geo-person-search-input), map canvas (geo-map-canvas), sidebar toggle (toggle-sidebar-button), and filter buttons
